title: Runtime
description: The slots, the port engines listen on, how long starts and health checks may take, and dev mode.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The kind and version this file is written in; always its first field.

title.description: The name clients show for this record; the file's own name when empty.
title.title: Title

slots.description: The seats for models: main for the agent's, fast for completion (design 0006), vision for the model that reads images on the CPU (design 0008).
slots.title: Slots

port.description: Where an engine listens, until the gateway takes this port (design 0001 §9.2).
port.title: Engines' port

ports.description: A port of its own for a slot whose engine runs beside another; the rest take the engines' port.
ports.title: Slots' ports

model_name.description: The model name the gateway puts in each request it passes to the engine; empty: the model's id in Clank's catalog.
model_name.title: Model name

tight_mib.description: A fit with less spare GPU memory than this, in MiB, is tight.
tight_mib.title: Tight below

start_seconds.description: How long an engine may take to be ready, in seconds.
start_seconds.title: Time to start

health_seconds.description: How often a running engine is asked.
health_seconds.title: Health every

cloud_health_seconds.description: How often a cloud model's provider is asked whether it still takes the key (it costs nothing).
cloud_health_seconds.title: Cloud health every

fallback_preset.description: What clank work, clank code and This folder load when the main slot runs nothing and no configuration has worked yet (design 0015 §13).
fallback_preset.title: Fallback preset

dev_mode.description: For testing (decisions 0149 and 0152): while on, every cloud provider is asked for any of a model's providers (data_collection allow), those that may keep or train on what they are sent too, whatever its own record says, from the next request; and every workspace's agent reaches every public host at once, without a question (private addresses still never), OpenCode fetching and searching the web from its next start. The console's header says so. clank dev on, clank dev off.
dev_mode.title: Dev mode
